$comment: Random travel events (spec §11.1), rolled per travel day. regions: lore region ids (empty = anywhere). weather/timeOfDay filters are optional. Monster ids are SRD 5.2.1. Checks use SRD skills; DCs from the SRD DC table.

events.text: A merchant caravan rumbles past, its drivers trading road gossip about bandits to the south.
A patrol of the Dawn Lance rides by, banners snapping, and salutes travelers who keep to the road.
Bandits step out from behind a toppled cart, demanding a toll.
A pack of wolves shadows the trail, then closes in.
The bridge ahead has washed out in the rain.

check.success: You ford the swollen stream without losing footing.
check.failure: The current drags you under before you scramble out, soaked and battered.

events.text: A moss-grown roadside shrine to a forgotten saint; someone has left fresh flowers.
Pale lights bob over the marsh, beckoning off the path.

check.success: You keep to the true path and let the lights drift away.
check.failure: You follow the lights for an hour before realising you have walked in a circle.

events.text: Bloated shapes rise from the bog, reaching for warm flesh.
Giant frogs lurk in the reeds beside the causeway.
The causeway gives way to sucking mud.

check.success: You haul yourself free and find firmer ground.
check.failure: You lose an hour and most of your strength wrestling free of the mire.

events.text: A cart of shrouded bodies creaks past, its driver masked and silent.
A whine fills the air as stirges descend.
Dolphins race the bow, and the crew cheer them on.
A red-sailed sloop runs alongside and grappling hooks fly.
A squall slams into the ship and a wave sweeps the deck.

check.success: You grab a line and ride out the wave.
check.failure: You are hurled against the rail before the crew haul you back.

events.text: Fins circle the becalmed ship as sharks scent the galley scraps.
Giant crabs clatter out of the surf toward the coast path.
A sealed crate bobs past, stamped with the mark of a company that sank years ago.
A lost traveler asks for directions and shares a pipe of tobacco in thanks.
You make camp under a sky full of stars; the night passes peacefully.
